message.scp_unleashed.scp492.refuses: It is all straw and stitching inside. There is nothing for the controller to take hold of.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp492.0: Kids keep talking about a little straw pirate wandering out past the old fairground.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp492.1: Friendly, by every account. Shy of anyone carrying a flame.
SCP-492, "Captain Jack": a small, crudely stitched pirate figure of burlap and straw that walks, talks and has opinions about everything. Safe-class.
It is curious about people but wary at first. It will not come near a naked flame for anything.
Those it trusts get a sharp lookout and a polite tip of the hat. It feels no pain, though its seams have their limits.
It never spawns naturally. Its file comes from the Archive.
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.title: Captain Jack
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.caption: SCP-492 in its quarters, partway through a story. It asked that the photograph show its good side.
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.0.text.0: SCP-492 is housed in standard on-site living quarters, furnished according to its own requests where these do not interfere with containment. It holds Level 1 clearance and may move about the site in the company of a member of staff.
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.0.text.1: A locator tag is sewn into its back seam, with its consent. A sewing kit and spare thread are kept at the guard post outside its quarters.
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.0.text.2: **Open flames, lit torches and fire-starting tools are not permitted in its quarters, and staff are asked not to carry them in its presence.** %rAdditional measures withheld.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.1.text.0: SCP-492 is a humanoid figure roughly sixty centimetres tall, made of coarse burlap stuffed with straw and held together with uneven cross-stitched seams. It has two black buttons for eyes and a stitched grin. Its arms and body are lumpy and oversized, as though stuffed in a hurry.
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.1.text.1: It is dressed as a pirate: a black tricorn hat bearing a skull and crossbones and a red feather, a red bandana, a small gold earring, a sleeveless black vest and a leather bandolier.
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.1.text.2: SCP-492 was once a costumed figure in the pirate attraction of the abandoned %rWillowmere Point%r Amusement Park. Whatever machinery it held was removed long ago, yet it walks, sees, hears and speaks. Its sight appears to be tied to its button eyes.
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.1.text.3: SCP-492 feels no pain and shrugs off blows that would injure a person. Struck hard enough, it collapses in a heap until its seams are mended. It has an intense fear of fire.
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.1.text.4: SCP-492 is polite, talkative and fond of company. Staff refer to it as "Captain Jack". It keeps a close watch over people it considers friends and is quick to call out when something hostile approaches.
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.2.title: Addendum 492-1: Recovery
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.2.text.0: A group of teenagers who broke into the closed park reported "things coming alive" inside. Foundation search teams found nothing at first. Some days later Agent %rMarsh%r came across SCP-492 on the outskirts of the park and talked it into coming quietly.
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.2.text.1: Agent %rMarsh%r noted that SCP-492 would not come near anyone carrying a lantern, and that it warmed to him only once he set his down and spoke to it plainly.
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.2.text.2: The teenagers were given Class-B amnestics. A surveillance team remains posted at the park.
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.3.title: Addendum 492-2: Interview Excerpt
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.3.text.0: **Interviewer:** How long have you been aware of yourself?
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.3.text.1: **SCP-492:** Couldn't tell you exactly. I counted sunrises for a while, then I lost count somewhere in the thousands.
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.3.text.3: **SCP-492:** Is that bad? It felt like a long time. I wasted a good many of them sitting in that boat.
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.3.text.4: **Interviewer:** Did you meet anyone else like you?
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.3.text.5: **SCP-492:** Not to talk to. The big ones on the dinosaur ride never wanted a conversation. Mostly they wanted to eat me.
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.4.title: Addendum 492-3: Note
dossier.scp_unleashed.492.page.4.text: Following Incident 492-04, in which SCP-492 was flattened by a falling crate and lay motionless until a junior researcher stitched it back together, it has thanked that researcher every morning without fail. It has also asked, twice, whether the crate was hostile.
